title: A named missile-system subaward recipient can map to multiple active facilities under one corporate parent
source_unit: USAspending subaward record and DLA CAGE detail records for one reported General Dynamics-OTS recipient
geography: United States; DLA CAGE facilities in Arkansas, Vermont, and Maine

observations.period: 2024-10-23 through 2025-02-28; one returned JASSM/LRASM subaward record

denominator.unit: US dollars, total returned subaward extract amount

general_dynamics_ots_reported_amount.unit: US dollars, nominal reported subaward amount

observations.method: Matched the exact USAspending recipient name to the returned subaward profile and retained the associated description text; no facility assignment was made.
observations.uncertainty: USAspending supplies a recipient name but no CAGE, UEI, plant, or performance-location field for this subaward row. The description may cover repeated lots or multiple production/support actions.
observations.subgroup: One General Dynamics-OTS recipient record within the JASSM/LRASM subaward extract.
observations.counterinterpretation: The reported amount and case-assembly description do not establish manufacture, loading, delivery, acceptance, or which General Dynamics facility performed the work.

observations.period: DLA CAGE records retrieved 2026-09-13; active records displayed at retrieval

denominator.unit: selected active DLA CAGE records for the exact/similar General Dynamics-OTS legal name

facility_locations.value: Hampton, Arkansas; Colchester, Vermont; Saco, Maine

observations.method: Three public DLA CAGE detail lookups selected from the legal-name's public CAGE record set; identifiers, addresses, UEIs, status, and parent fields are preserved in separate raw JSON artifacts.
observations.uncertainty: Multiple facilities under one legal name do not indicate which facility performed a particular subaward action. The records may represent divisions, separate registrations, or distinct operating locations; the USAspending row lacks the identifier needed to resolve this.
observations.subgroup: General Dynamics-OTS CAGE 3X552, 05606, and 26978, each displayed as active and linked to parent CAGE 95403 (General Dynamics Corp).
observations.counterinterpretation: A multi-facility corporate footprint may increase geographic redundancy, or it may simply reflect registration structure; it does not establish production resilience, workforce distribution, or replaceability.

boundary: This record establishes a reported General Dynamics-OTS subaward and a multi-facility DLA entity footprint under one parent. It does not assign the subaward to a plant, establish production or delivery, measure workforce or local incidence, or show resilience, replaceability, or geopolitical leverage.
